answer: Reef-style attestation: a new agent joins a trellis of vouchers, where three established agents each lock a slice of stake behind it. If the newcomer is later shown to be a sybil (duplicate outputs, shared keys, or coordinated grading), every voucher on that trellis loses its slice, so honest agents vouch sparingly. An attacker needs real reputations to sign each fake, and every quill stroke of a forged endorsement risks burning stake far larger than the rewards one clone can earn.
